source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves emphatic freedom, command, and yoke image.
key_decisions.before: For freedom Christ set us free. Therefore stand firm and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.
key_decisions.after: For freedom Christ set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be held again under a yoke of slavery.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For freedom Christ has set us free; stand fast therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps personal emphasis and conditional warning.
key_decisions.before: Look—I, Paul, tell you that if you are circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.
key_decisions.after: Look, I, Paul, tell you that if you are circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Look, I, Paul, say to you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains male specificity and total obligation.
key_decisions.before: Again I testify to every man who is circumcised that he is obligated to keep the whole Law.
key_decisions.after: Again I testify to every man who is circumcised that he is obligated to do the whole law.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I testify again to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is bound to keep the whole law.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps severing wordplay and grace contrast.
key_decisions.before: You who seek to be set right by the Law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
key_decisions.after: You who seek to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You who would be justified by the law are severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Spirit, faith, hope, and waiting.
key_decisions.before: For through the Spirit, by trust, we eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness.
key_decisions.after: For through the Spirit, by faith, we eagerly await the hope of righteousness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For through the Spirit, by faith, we wait for the hope of righteousness.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps bodily statuses and active faith/love relation.
key_decisions.before: In Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any power, but trust working through love.
key_decisions.after: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision accomplishes anything, but faith working through love does.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts for anything, but faith working through love.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves race image and personal interference.
key_decisions.before: You were running well. Who cut in on you and kept you from obeying the truth?
key_decisions.after: You were running well. Who cut in on you and kept you from obeying the truth?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You were running well; who hindered you from obeying the truth?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps counterfactual logic, persecution, and scandal.
key_decisions.before: Brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been removed.
key_decisions.after: But as for me, brothers and sisters, if I still proclaim circumcision, why am I still persecuted? In that case, the offense of the cross has been abolished.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been removed.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul's harsh bodily wordplay rather than euphemizing it.
key_decisions.before: I wish those who are unsettling you would go all the way and mutilate themselves!
key_decisions.after: I wish those who are unsettling you would go all the way and castrate themselves!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I wish that those who are unsettling you would mutilate themselves!

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps freedom and voluntary enslavement in deliberate tension.
key_decisions.before: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters. Only do not use freedom as an opportunity for the flesh; instead, through love serve one another as slaves.
key_decisions.after: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters. Only do not use freedom as an opportunity for the flesh; instead, through love serve one another as enslaved people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains violent animal imagery and reciprocal destruction.
key_decisions.before: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out or you will be consumed by one another.
key_decisions.after: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out that you are not consumed by one another.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out that you are not consumed by one another.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps movement image and strong negation.
key_decisions.before: But I say: walk by the Spirit, and you will certainly not carry out the desire of the flesh.
key_decisions.after: But I say: walk by the Spirit, and you will certainly not carry out the desire of the flesh.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves mutual opposition and resulting constraint.
key_decisions.before: For the flesh desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. These oppose each other so that you do not simply do whatever you want.
key_decisions.after: For the flesh desires what is against the Spirit, and the Spirit what is against the flesh. These oppose each other, so that you do not do whatever you want.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the desires of the flesh are against the Spirit, and the desires of the Spirit are against the flesh; for these are opposed to each other, to keep you from doing the things you would.

key_decisions.before: Now the works of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality,
key_decisions.after: Now the works of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, debauchery,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now the works of the flesh are evident: sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the full social and religious catalogue.
key_decisions.before: idolatry, sorcery, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, divisions, factions,
key_decisions.after: idolatry, sorcery, hostilities, strife, jealousy, fits of anger, selfish ambitions, divisions, factions,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: idolatry, sorcery, enmity, strife, jealousy, fits of anger, rivalries, dissensions, factions,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves continuing category, prior warning, practice, and inheritance.
key_decisions.before: envy, drunkenness, wild parties, and things like these. I warn you, as I warned you before, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s kingdom.
key_decisions.after: envy, drunkenness, wild parties, and things like these. I warn you, as I warned you before, that those who practice such things will not inherit God's kingdom.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: envy, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these. I warn you, as I warned you before, that those who do such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps singular fruit and the first seven qualities.
key_decisions.before: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
key_decisions.after: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains violent crucifixion image and embodied impulses.
key_decisions.before: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
key_decisions.after: Now those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

key_decisions.before: If we live by the Spirit, let us also keep in step with the Spirit.
key_decisions.after: If we live by the Spirit, let us also keep in step with the Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If we live by the Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit.
